title: First UFO recorded within a week of the Trinity atomic test

tellings.quote:
the first UFO ever recorded
was within 7 Days of the detonation of
the first atomic weapon in Trinity in
New
Mexico that's the first one that ever
appeared

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest on a podcast, says, passing on what he was told, that the first UFO ever recorded appeared within seven days of Trinity, the first atomic bomb test, set off in New Mexico in 1945. If true, it would tie the arrival of UFOs to the start of the nuclear age.
